findings.description:
BalancerPriceOracle.getTWAP() (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_045.sol#185-222) uses a dangerous strict equality:
	- prev.timestamp == 0 || last.timestamp == 0 (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_045.sol#191)

BalancerPriceOracle.getTWAP() (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_045.sol#185-222) uses a dangerous strict equality:
	- twap == 0 (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_045.sol#217)

BalancerPriceOracle.getPrice() (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_045.sol#128-143) ignores return value by (None,balances,None) = IVault(balancerVault).getPoolTokens(balancerPoolId) (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_045.sol#130)

BalancerPriceOracle.constructor(address,bytes32,address,uint256,uint256,uint256) (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_045.sol#78-124) ignores return value by (tokens,None,None) = IVault(balancerVault).getPoolTokens(_balancerPoolId) (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_045.sol#113)

BalancerPriceOracle.updatePrice() (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_045.sol#148-180) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- last.timestamp > 0 && dt < minUpdateInterval (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_045.sol#155)
	- dt > 0 (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_045.sol#169)

BalancerPriceOracle.getTWAP() (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_045.sol#185-222) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- prev.timestamp == 0 || last.timestamp == 0 (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_045.sol#191)
	- age > maxStaleness (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_045.sol#197)
	- dtWin < minTwapWindow (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_045.sol#203)
	- twap == 0 (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_045.sol#217)

StakingBase._getRewardReceiversAndAmounts(uint256,address,address,uint256,uint256) (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_044.sol#669-757) performs a multiplication on the result of a division:
	- operatorReward = reward / (totalNumReceivers) (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_044.sol#695)
	- amounts[numInstances] = reward - (numInstances * operatorReward) (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_044.sol#706)

StakingBase._getRewardReceiversAndAmounts(uint256,address,address,uint256,uint256) (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_044.sol#669-757) uses a dangerous strict equality:
	- rewardDistributionType == RewardDistributionType.ServiceOwner (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_044.sol#707)

StakingBase._checkRatioPass(address,uint256[],uint256) (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_044.sol#468-493) uses a dangerous strict equality:
	- success && returnData.length == 32 (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_044.sol#489)

StakingBase._getRewardReceiversAndAmounts(uint256,address,address,uint256,uint256) (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_044.sol#669-757) uses a dangerous strict equality:
	- receivers.length == 0 || receivers.length != amounts.length (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_044.sol#733)

StakingBase._getRewardReceiversAndAmounts(uint256,address,address,uint256,uint256) (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_044.sol#669-757) uses a dangerous strict equality:
	- rewardDistributionType == RewardDistributionType.Proportional (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_044.sol#682)

StakingBase._getRewardReceiversAndAmounts(uint256,address,address,uint256,uint256) (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_044.sol#669-757) uses a dangerous strict equality:
	- rewardDistributionType == RewardDistributionType.ServiceMultisig (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_044.sol#715)
